measurementLimitations: Single contended local host; not production infrastructure
Generator capped at two CPUs, 512MiB, 256 VUs; high offered rates were not achieved
Achieved RPS includes unsuccessful/rejected requests and drain time
Initial partial run preserved separately; output-pipe stall was fixed before the complete matrix
Fault cases intentionally have no availability thresholds; completed is not a passing SLO
